title: pre-existing test failure: run_command_nonzero_exit_is_not_rust_error on Windows
description: The test tools::run_command::tests::run_command_nonzero_exit_is_not_rust_error in src/moeb/src/tools/run_command.rs fails on Windows with os error 267 (ERROR_DIRECTORY). The failure originates in fn wd() at line 125 which calls std::env::current_dir().unwrap(); on Windows this can fail when the process working directory is set to a path that becomes invalid. This test was already failing before this run's changes (only markdown skill files were modified) and is not caused by this run.
proposed_resolution: Fix the wd() helper in run_command.rs to handle the Windows os error 267 case gracefully, or change the test to set an explicit CWD rather than relying on std::env::current_dir(). Consider running the CI test suite in an environment where the working directory is always a valid Windows path.
